glosses: To take a temporary rest, take a break for a short period after an effort.
To stop (an activity) for a while.

examples.text: The general public could therefore have been forgiven for thinking that work on the new station had stopped. But pausing work on an active construction site of this size is not straightforward.

glosses: To interrupt an activity and wait.

examples.text: When telling the scary story, he paused for effect.

glosses: A temporary stop or rest; an intermission of action; interruption; suspension; cessation.

glosses: A short time for relaxing and doing something else.
